notes: Partition verified: s001–s017 and t001–t027 each appear once.

Both bəṣēl phrases are recast as 'X is a defence', so each preposition is `unrepresented` under rule 40 — the governed noun keeps an English word of its own, which is what keeps rule 30's fusion from reaching it — and each ṣēl carries the predicate noun with its copula.
'even as' and the complementizer 'that' are `added`: the Hebrew juxtaposes the two clauses with no conjunction and writes no subordinator (rules 14, 55).

'the life of him that hath it' divides under rule 43's noun-of-possession paragraph, with the supplied antecedent, relative and 'hath' on bəʿālê and the head of the verb's unit on 'life'; the alternative head 'preserveth' is named in that unit's note.
